```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(typstcv)

source("gather_data.R")

# Entries as typstcv expects: one date string per row, current roles first
prepare_entries <- function(data, section_id) {
  data |>
    filter(in_resume, section == section_id) |>
    mutate(
      # Guard against start/end entered in the wrong order
      first_year = pmin(start, end, na.rm = TRUE),
      last_year = if_else(is.na(end), NA_real_, pmax(start, end, na.rm = TRUE)),
      date = case_when(
        is.na(last_year) ~ paste(first_year, "- Present"),
        first_year == last_year ~ as.character(first_year),
        .default = paste(first_year, "-", last_year)
      )
    ) |>
    # Current positions first, then most recent end year
    arrange(desc(is.na(last_year)), desc(last_year), desc(first_year)) |>
    rename(location = loc, description = institution)
}

detail_cols <- c("description_1", "description_2", "description_3", "description_4")
```
